reviews.text: Robert has outstanding customer service, something you just don’t find these days with most businesses. Our pool was in BAD shape after the winter along with some equipment damage and within 3 days Robert had our pool back in shape and running. Some equipment replacements will need to be made but Robert tried his hardest to utilize our current setup to get our pool back up and running efficiently. We are excited to continue with weekly service. Believe all these 5 star reviews, you will not be disappointed with your experience.
reviews.author: Alison Ewing

reviews.text: If I could rate Robert 10 stars I would. They are amazing and fairly priced. He was the only pool company that I called that was willing to come out for a free estimate to assess the condition of the pool. Everyone else wanted me to send pic then recommended I drain it and start over.  Robert told me it wasn’t that bad and he could turn it around in 24 hours and that is exactly what he did. He also checked in to make sure everything was good via text. Not only is he professional he is also very kind. You do not need to look any further for a pool cleaning company you have found it with True pool care. He took my pool from green swamp to crystal clear in 24 hours.
reviews.author: Shawna Wilson

reviews.text: Robert was amazing, with price, quality and just all around great guy! Highly recommend Tru Pool Care! Thanks Robert for your service visit!!
reviews.author: Jeffrey Maurer

reviews.text: I can’t say enough positive things about this pool company. I’m a first time pool owner and stumbled upon this company while looking for a cleaning/chemical crew for weekly cleanings and chemicals. The first time I met Robert he spent 4 hours at our home diagnosing our pool prior to me even signing with his company. We’ve been using his company ever since and couldn’t be more grateful for them. The entire crew is hard working, kind, honest, and diligent. They text you every time they’re in route to your property and provide you with detailed reports on their services when they clean or put chemicals in your pool so you know what they did.  Anytime I had a question or concern with our pool, I reached out to Robert and he was willing to assist with our needs the SAME DAY. They’ve made owning a pool very easy for us as we knew nothing about pools when we first moved to Texas. I love how we can come to them at anytime with our questions and they’re quick to respond and very thorough in explaining how everything works so we understand what they’re doing. If I could give this company 10 stars I would and I encourage anyone looking for a pool company to use them. You won’t be disappointed!
reviews.author: Chelsy Ann

reviews.text:
Our DE filter needed cleaning and had a small leak so I shopped around for best quote.  True Pool Care was by far the cheapest at only $125 for cleaning.  I was able to talk directly to the owner. Unlike other companies he did not try to sell me on monthly cleaning commitment.

When he arrived I mentioned my robot cleaner had not been cleaning bottom of pool. He said he could take a look.  He was determined to get it working properly. He spent over an hour but managed to repair it. Then he cleaned my DE filter and was able to fix leak.  I also showed him a jet that wasn't blowing...once again fixed.

Since he was here he offered to look over all equipment and test water. He advised me on chemicals needed and even added conditioner for me at no charge.

I can see why this company always gets 5 stars. Robert was very considerate, knowledgeable, and helpful.  He fixed all issues and only charged me for the DE cleaning.  Other companies would have charged for the 3 hours he was here.

He also sent pictures of everything he did, advice he gave and confirmed he locked our gate. Very thorough!

If you're looking for a pool service...look no more. Robert at True Pool Care is trustworthy and very skilled at what he does. That's hard to find with corporate Pool companies!
reviews.author: Jenny Baker

reviews.text: The True pool care team are absolutely outstanding. If there is an issue they respond immediately. Very professional! Good value for the service they provide also.
reviews.author: Andrew Ventimiglia

reviews.text:
This summer I was looking for a change from our last pool company as I wasnt happy with the monthly service we were receiving. After researching on Google maps I found True Pool Care and decided to give them a call. Robert answered and offered to come by the same day. He reviewed my pool concerns, gave me feedback on causes and potential solutions,  checked the chemicals, and took photos. Based upon his customer service we decided to give him a try and since then we have not been disappointed with our experience.

Tru Pool Care is a small owned business,  which I prefer because I like to get to know the people coming in and out of my yard. Robert is consistent and timely, and communicate if there are any anticipated delays. He goes above and beyond to service our pool and ensure we have a great experience. He's knowledgeable, reasonably priced, and very personable. I'm glad we found True Pool Care and would highly recommend them for their awesome work and service!
reviews.author: Sweet-E

reviews.text: Our experience with True Pool Care has been exceptional. Robert and the guys are professional, timely, and thorough. It really feels like they take care of our pool like it is their own. Highly recommend to anyone looking for solid, quality pool maintenance.
reviews.author: McKee Family

data.summary: The reviews appear highly authentic in content, with specific details and varied customer experiences. However, the perfect 5.0 rating with only 50 reviews and no negative feedback in the sample raises mild suspicion, though this could be explained by a new, high-quality business. The lack of presence on other review platforms limits cross-verification.
fake_signals: No negative or neutral reviews in sample

positive_evidence: Owner spent extra time diagnosing pool and repairing robot without extra charge
Follow-up texts to ensure service quality

authentic_signals: Specific project details (DE filter cleaning, robot repair, winter damage)
Mention of owner's name (Robert) and crew
Specific pricing and service details mentioned
